brief: All-white gambrel barn about 36 ft wide and 64 ft long: white vertical siding on the low walls with a few sliding track doors, and a big gambrel roof in light grey diamond-pattern asphalt shingles, projecting in a pointed hay hood at the gable peak. A galvanized metal ventilator cupola with a stacked bell-shaped cap sits mid-ridge, with lightning rods along the ridge. A small weathered-shingle lean-to addition at one end; corn grows up to its walls.
